mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months) signals an aggressive monetary tightening, which typically reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for the signal in that regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (inflation) indicates increasing price pressures that typically lead to central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising (3-month change > 0), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong monthly job growth (exceeding 0.5% over three months) indicates a robust labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a broad economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that typically prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
